name: Central Glass Co., Ltd.
summary: Central Glass Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the chemical and glass businesses in Japan, Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company offers glass and automotive products, electronic materials, semiconductor, pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals, houses and industrial facilities, fluorine compound products, heat insulation materials, batteries, fertilizers, and other products. It serves applied chemicals, medi-chemicals, electronic materials, energy materials, fertilizers, architectural glass, automotive glass, and glass fiber.
